META_NOTES.ring_note: a ring row is sampled inside EveryOneMinute before the mod's queue drains that minute: row k reads the state drain k-1 left, and row k + 1's body.met is what drain k billed
META_NOTES.eat_note: a networked eat ends in real time, 232 x 20 ms, whatever the clock (#3766)
META_NOTES.spawn_note: every eaten or carried item is spawned by RCON additem and confirmed by the server's item.get id (ruling T2-11); an unconfirmed spawn voids its phase
META_NOTES.frame_note: no frame window is graded in this session (no tick.ring), so no drop_windows apply
META_NOTES.twin_note: the harness has no movement key press: the endurance branch of ISFitnessAction:update's line 39 is driven as the movement end's twin (#3736)

LOAD.item.get after the spawn: an id for Base.BarBell and TKX.Unit50, none before
LOAD.falsifier: an id missing on a live bus, or the load under LOAD_MIN_KG

SET_B.burpees 60: the flag shows within SET_START_CAP_M (one retry after a rest) and the record reads burpees while it runs
SET_B.reading: its length and how it ended (timer, or before the ask by the endurance branch)
SET_B.unmeasured: both asks refused (never falsified on a live bus)

SWEAT_ON.fluids.sweatActive: true on a ring row between the set's first flagged row and 6 h after its clear
SWEAT_ON.predicted only: when the set ran at least 1.1 x the EMA threshold -EMA_MIN ln(1 - p B / ((1 - p) S)) (the docstring's derivation); else a reading

SWEAT_OFF.reading: the first row after the clear that reads false, its hours after the clear and ratio

C26.the eat's candidate drains: falling raw (> FALL_EPS against the row before, or the flag's clear), not moving, not flagged -> billed body.met == COMPENDIUM.Default within 1e-9
C26.trivial: the stripped rate at the eat under 1.55, or every met candidate's old_gate_falling true (the old gate would have billed it the same)
C26.void: the load or the food unconfirmed, the eat not landed, or the bus dead
C26.unmeasured: no candidate drain meets the conditions
C26.falsifier: a candidate drain meeting the conditions that bills otherwise

CANCEL.action.cancel: ok, started true, stopped true, cleared true
CANCEL.record: nil at the clear and REST_M later
CANCEL.falsifier: any of these off on a live bus

TWIN.server stats.set ENDURANCE: 0.05: the flag clears within 12.0 s on the server route, before the set's own timer
TWIN.record: nil at the clear and REST_M later
TWIN.falsifier: the server route does not clear the flag, or the stops or record off
TWIN.TWIN_CLIENT: a reading: the client's own stats.set when the server's did not clear it

X33.guard arm: cancels +1; landed unchanged; the item on the server with its hungChange unchanged; the server's calories unchanged within 1e-6
X33.readings: the completed arm (eats +1, landed +1, item gone) and the normal cancelled arm
X33.falsifier: a landing, a changed item or changed calories after a cancel that reached the server
X33.unmeasured: the arm not run, the cancel not started, or cancels not +1

Z.players: answers a list (the server alive at the end)

deviations: The load is 2 x Base.BarBell (12 kg); the C-26 food is TKX.Unit50 (0.1 kg), the lightest TKX food.
Pre-run edit after the Opus review of f099c44a: C26 grades trivial when every met candidate has old_gate_falling true.
Pre-run edit: SET_START_CAP_M 6 game minutes (was 3) and one retry after a rest, as x37 did; a set refused twice grades unmeasured, never falsified on a live bus.

Pre-run edit: SWEAT_RULE is the graded claim; SWEAT_ON is a reading unless the set ran SWEAT_ON_MARGIN x the 6 h EMA threshold derived from K.fluids.losses (the docstring); the thermoregulator's fluids multiplier and the record's fluids.sweatK are read for it.
Pre-run edit: C26's load and intake reads run in B while the set runs, so the eat follows the clear at once.
